create_RewardMeanNetwork: create a RewardMeanNetwork with belief_size, state_size, and hidden_size for reward prediction
build_RewardMeanNetwork_forward: build a forward pass through RewardMeanNetwork that returns a squeezed reward tensor
create_RewardModel: create a RewardModel with x and y network sizes and configurable stddev for reward modeling
run_RewardModel_get_distn_and_x_mean: run get_distn_and_x_mean on a RewardModel to get a Normal distribution and x mean
test_RewardModel_forward: test the RewardModel forward method to return a Normal distribution from a latent state
